description: This file contains the implementation of ReadSubjectExtractor class that extracts read-subjects as topics from messages in a pub/sub system. It includes methods to instantiate the extractor and retrieve topics based on message headers.

classes.name: ReadSubjectExtractor
classes.description: A class that extracts read-subjects as topics from message headers in a pub/sub system. It is parameterized with a message type that extends WithDittoHeaders.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReadSubjectExtractor for the specified message type.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of topic strings derived from the read-granted subjects in the message headers.
